desc: Fall head over peels for Strawberry Banana Cheerios, flavored with other natural flavors. Every bowl brings the delightful taste of strawberries and bananas to your breakfast table. Made with real fruit purees and other natural flavors, plus whole grain oats as the first ingredient, these tasty Os deliver spoonfuls of wholesome goodness. The gluten free cereal contains no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources. Every serving provides 21g whole grains (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium, and 12 vitamins and minerals. Strawberry Banana Cheerios Cereal can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Strawberry Banana Cheerios Cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Strawberry Banana Cheerios Cereal provides .75 grams per serving. Pass this sweetened whole grain oat cereal around the family table. Beyond a great start to your morning, pour a bagful for gluten free snacks to take on the go. Or use the little Os to make cereal bars and kids snacks. Cheerios are also great gluten free snacks for kids. Whether you're looking for a tasty breakfast cereal or a crispy ingredient for lunch box treats, General Mills cereals spread goodness from tots to grown ups.
features:
DELICIOUS TASTE: A sweetened, first ingredient whole grain oat cereal with the taste of strawberries and bananas; Made with real fruit purees and other natural flavors

CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL* as part of a heart healthy diet; *3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease - this Cheerios cereal provides .75g per serving

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: First ingredient whole grain oats; Each serving offers 21g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily); An ideal pantry staple with a good source of calcium, and 12 vitamins and minerals

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour a bowl with milk for a gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some as gluten free snacks on the go, or add to homemade cereal bars; No artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources

CONTAINS: One 14.9 oz Large Size cereal box of Strawberry Banana Cheerios flavored with other natural flavors
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Banana Puree, Corn Starch, Strawberry Puree, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Color (vegetable juice, fruit juice), Natural Flavor, Citric Acid, Ascorbic Acid. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
